name: kingbot-platform
description: KINGBOT AI Trading System - dashboard, bots, signals and broker connections

PORT.description: Port the server listens on. Render supplies this automatically.

APP_URL.description: Public URL of the deployed app, used for OAuth redirects and CORS

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string (e.g. from MongoDB Atlas)

JWT_SECRET.description: Long random string used to sign session tokens

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth client ID from Google Cloud Console, used for Sign in with Google

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret from Google Cloud Console

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The only email address allowed to sign in to /admin. A matching admin account is created automatically on first boot.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the admin account. Change this from the default before going live.
